title: Pan-Seared Fish with Chinese Vegetables
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring pan-seared fish with crunchy vegetables and a hint of Chinese spices.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Season the fish with chinese five-spice powder.
Add 1 tbsp of sesame oil to the pan and sear the fish for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Remove the fish from the pan and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of sesame oil to the pan, then add the sliced carrots and zucchini.
Cook the vegetables for 3-4 minutes, or until they start to soften.
Add the soy sauce to the pan and stir to combine.
Return the fish to the pan and serve with the vegetables and sauce.
